headline: Congress named a Pearland, Texas post office building after Endy Nddiobong Ekpanya.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 2700 Cullen Boulevard in Pearland, Texas. The building will now be officially called the "Endy Nddiobong Ekpanya Post Office Building." It does not change how the post office operates or what services it provides.
when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on March 16, 2018, and the new name took effect when it was signed.
